export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get a copy of your profile, saved addresses, appointments, reviews, messages, saved professionals and support requests as a JSON file.
export.hint: Prepared instantly. Keep the file somewhere safe — it contains personal information.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.intro: This permanently closes your Kept account. Here's what happens:
delete.erased: Your name, email, phone, photo, saved addresses and saved professionals are erased, and you're signed out everywhere.
delete.upcoming: {count, plural, one {Your upcoming appointment is cancelled under each business's cancellation policy, including any refund it allows.} other {Your # upcoming appointments are cancelled under each business's cancellation policy, including any refund it allows.}}
delete.upcomingNone: Any upcoming appointments are cancelled under each business's cancellation policy.
delete.records: Records businesses and tax rules depend on — past appointments, payments and reviews — are kept, but shown as from “Deleted user”.
delete.permanent: This can't be undone. You can sign up again later with the same email, starting fresh.
delete.blocked: You own {businesses}. Close the business or transfer it to someone else from your <link>business settings</link> before deleting your account, so its clients aren't left without answers.
delete.copyFirst: Prefer a copy first? Download your data above.
delete.willCancel: {count, plural, one {# upcoming appointment will be cancelled.} other {# upcoming appointments will be cancelled.}}

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: {count, plural, one {# professional you've saved.} other {# professionals you've saved.}} Openings below are live from their calendars.
